new='''    description: |-
      Small changes to the Track Star web app (~/sc/demos/track-star), from
      a ticket to a merge into main: implement, check, merge.

      Only implement takes judgment: a person makes each change together with
      the agent, in the work item's own worktree and branch. check and merge
      are fixed steps, run as swamp workflows: check runs `deno task check`
      (format, lint, type check, tests) on exactly the committed SHA, and
      merge fast-forwards main to exactly that SHA. A failed check or a
      refused merge sends the work back to implement. No person approves
      along the way; done means the checked commit is on main. Only
      abandoning work is a person's choice.

    stages:
      - id: implement
        initial: true
        maxCycles: 5
        tracker: { status: in_progress }
        description: >-
          Implement the change with the person in the work item's worktree,
          and commit it.
        work:
          mode: interactive
          skills: []
          systemPrompt: |
            Prepare the work item's worktree (it is reused, with its branch,
            after a failed check or a refused merge):

              swamp model method run track-star-repo ensure_worktree \\
                --input path=${HOME}/sc/demos/track-star-worktrees/{{branch}} \\
                --input root=${HOME}/sc/demos/track-star-worktrees \\
                --input branch={{branch}} --input base=main

            Implement the ticket's change together with the person in that
            worktree, keeping it small. Never edit or commit in
            ~/sc/demos/track-star itself: main stays checked out and clean
            there for the merge. Commit the work on {{branch}}, leaving the
            worktree clean, then record change-summary with the branch and
            the full 40-character SHA of the commit.

            After a failed check, read the injected checks and the workflow
            run it names (swamp workflow history logs <runId>), fix what
            failed, commit, and record change-summary again. After a refused
            merge, read the injected merge run's log; if main moved, rebase
            {{branch}} on main, commit, and record change-summary again.
          let:
            branch: item.key
          context:
            inject: [change-summary, checks, merge]
        artifacts:
          - name: change-summary
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [summary, branch, commit, files]
              additionalProperties: false
              properties:
                summary: { type: string, minLength: 1 }
                branch: { type: string, minLength: 1 }
                commit: { type: string, pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{40}$" }
                files: { type: array, minItems: 1, items: { type: string } }
        transitions:
          - name: submit
            to: check
            gates:
              - type: artifact-exists
                config: { artifact: change-summary }

      - id: check
        tracker: { status: in_progress }
        description: >-
          Run `deno task check` on the change-summary commit, through the
          track-star-check workflow. A pass merges; a failure goes back to
          implement.
        work:
          mode: workflow
          description: >-
            track-star-check checks out the exact commit in a fresh worktree,
            runs `deno task check` there with @swamp/deno-runner, and removes
            the worktree. The run fails when the check fails.
          workflow:
            name: track-star-check
            passAsInputs: [commit]
          let:
            commit: artifacts["change-summary"].payload.commit
          resultEvidence: checks
        evidence:
          - name: checks
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [status, runId, commit]
              properties:
                status: { enum: [succeeded, failed] }
                runId: { type: string, minLength: 1 }
                commit: { type: string, pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{40}$" }
        transitions:
          - name: passed
            to: merge
            gates:
              - type: evidence-recorded
                config: { name: checks, requireField: { status: succeeded } }
              - type: cel
                config:
                  expr: >-
                    evidence["checks"].payload.commit ==
                    artifacts["change-summary"].payload.commit
                  message: checks must be for the change-summary commit
          - name: failed
            to: implement
            description: >-
              `deno task check` failed, so the change goes back to be fixed.
              Bounded by implement's maxCycles.
            gates:
              - type: evidence-recorded
                config: { name: checks, requireField: { status: failed } }

      - id: merge
        tracker: { status: in_progress }
        description: >-
          Fast-forward main to the checked commit, through the
          track-star-merge workflow.
        work:
          mode: workflow
          description: >-
            track-star-merge removes the work item's worktree (refused if it
            has uncommitted changes), then fast-forwards main to exactly the
            commit with @swamp/git's merge method and deletes the branch. It
            refuses a branch that moved after the check, a dirty main, and a
            merge that is not a fast-forward.
          workflow:
            name: track-star-merge
            passAsInputs: [commit, branch]
          let:
            branch: artifacts["change-summary"].payload.branch
            commit: artifacts["change-summary"].payload.commit
          resultEvidence: merge
        evidence:
          - name: merge
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [status, runId, commit]
              properties:
                status: { enum: [succeeded, failed] }
                runId: { type: string, minLength: 1 }
                commit: { type: string, pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{40}$" }
        transitions:
          - name: merged
            to: done
            gates:
              - type: evidence-recorded
                config: { name: merge, requireField: { status: succeeded } }
              - type: cel
                config:
                  expr: >-
                    evidence["merge"].payload.commit ==
                    artifacts["change-summary"].payload.commit
                  message: the merged commit must be the checked commit
          - name: refused
            to: implement
            description: >-
              The merge was refused (main moved, so it is not a
              fast-forward, or the branch or worktree changed after the
              check), so the change goes back to be brought up to date and
              checked again. Bounded by implement's maxCycles.
            gates:
              - type: evidence-recorded
                config: { name: merge, requireField: { status: failed } }

      - id: done
        terminal: true
        tracker: { status: shipped }

      - id: abandoned
        terminal: true
        tracker: { status: closed }

    globalTransitions:
      - name: abandon
        to: abandoned
        manual: true
        description: >-
          A person drops the change. Manual, so only the person's word takes
          it.
'''

swamp issue feature --extension @swamp/stagecraft --title "stagecraft studio: show a factory's open tickets that have no work item yet on the Board" --body "$(cat <<'EOF'
## Problem

The studio Board (#2943) shows work items only. A ticket filed on the factory's tracker (`@swamp/stagecraft/create`) doesn't appear until it is claimed and its work item started, so the Board shows nothing about the queue of work waiting to start.

Repro: a factory bound to a built-in tracker (`ts`), and three tickets filed with `swamp workflow run @swamp/stagecraft/create --input tracker=ts ...` (ts-1..ts-3, status `open`), none claimed. `/f/<factory>/board` is empty. This doesn't depend on the definition: a factory whose initial stage is `plan` (starter.yaml) behaves the same, since no work item exists yet.

## Proposed solution

Add a column before the first stage on the Board, e.g. **Not started**, listing the bound tracker's tickets that are open and have no work item: display id, title, type, and how long since filing, with relations (blocked_by, parent_of) shown on the card. Opening one could show the Ticket tab (#2969) and the `claim` command to run. Once claimed, the ticket leaves the column and its work item's card appears in the initial stage.

The studio already reads tickets as the tracker last recorded them for the Ticket tab, so this could use the same read without calling the tracker. It should work the same for the built-in tracker, Linear and publisher-backed trackers.

## Alternatives considered

A `backlog` stage in the factory, with every ticket claimed and started as soon as it is filed, and a manual transition out. Downsides:
- It moves the backlog from the tracker into the factory, and every ticket needs a claim and start just to be visible.
- Work items pin the definition when they start, so items waiting in the backlog go stale across every factory change and need `reset --repin`.
- Every factory gets a stage that does no work.
EOF
